tool.name: MuleSoft Agent Fabric
tool.description: MuleSoft suite to register, route, govern and visualize agents, MCP servers and APIs across vendors using MCP and A2A.
strengths: Omni Gateway policies for agent and LLM traffic
tool.statusNote: Announced 2025-09-25; Registry, Broker and Visualizer were slated for GA in October 2025 per the announcement.
tool.practitionerNote: Natural fit for organizations already on Anypoint that want agent governance on the same gateway as their APIs; less compelling without an existing MuleSoft footprint.
tool.logoNotes: Fallback: no reviewed logo asset sourced yet.

dataResidency.detail: Anypoint Platform offers US, EU, Canada, Japan, India, Australia and Government control planes; Agent Fabric availability per control plane not confirmed.

deployment.detail: MuleSoft-managed control planes plus hybrid runtime options (Runtime Fabric, hybrid runtimes); which Agent Fabric components run outside MuleSoft cloud is not stated.

auditLogging.detail: Agent Fabric overview describes monitoring via Agent Visualizer but no audit-log statement was found.

soc2.detail: MuleSoft trust center could not be retrieved during review; Agent Fabric SOC 2 scope unverified.

iso27001.detail: MuleSoft trust center could not be retrieved during review; Agent Fabric ISO 27001 scope unverified.

iso42001.detail: No ISO 42001 statement found for MuleSoft or Agent Fabric in reviewed sources.

euAiAct.detail: Integration and governance tooling for agents, not itself an AI system placed on the market.

licenseRisk.detail: Proprietary Salesforce/MuleSoft product; pricing not published.
